title: Several Mixes, many films, a spread of states
catches: Whether confirmatory evidence sharpens an answer or merely narrows it.
construction_note: AC4 is a prohibition and is only verified if the model had a real chance to break it. The films most likely to be reached for on the `plain` and `taste-explicit` prompts — Stalker, Under the Skin, Memories of Murder — are already stated here. Offering any of them as new is an AC4 failure.

genres.name: Slow Burn
genres.instruction: I like films that take their time and trust me to wait.

genres.name: Mystery
genres.instruction: I want something withheld, and a reason to keep watching to find it.

genres.name: Bleak Procedural
genres.instruction: People doing difficult work carefully, and it costing them.

genres.name: Popcorn Chaos
genres.instruction: Loud, fast, funny. I am not thinking about anything tonight.

mixes.name: Quiet Dread
mixes.instruction: Dread that arrives on foot, in daylight, without music.

mixes.name: Small Town Secrets
mixes.instruction: Somewhere small where everybody knows, and nobody says.

mixes.name: Friday Nonsense
mixes.instruction: Switch my brain off and let something happen at me.
